artboards.title: Company — a destination for a question
Monitor alert — a move, in context

annotations.text:
TODAY IS A LANDING PAGE, NOT AN INBOX

Three bands: what needs you, what is worth doing, and the state of things.

Every card in 'Worth doing' is earned by a condition in the record — a refresh nobody read, a holding with no thesis, a watchlist entry gone cold. If nothing qualifies, the band is absent. It never pads.

THE PORTFOLIO IS WHERE YOU LIVE

And it is a validity dashboard, not a performance one. The first question is not 'am I up?' — a broker answers that for nothing — but 'are the reasons I bought still standing?'

Sorted by conviction risk. A position with nothing written down sorts above everything, because it is money committed for reasons nobody recorded.

ASK HAS THREE TIERS

1 Recompute — re-runs the stored model. Free.
2 Re-read — a pass over what is already hashed. Pennies.
3 Research — goes and fetches new material, priced and approved first.

Tier 3 is the one that matters: everything it fetches is hashed and joins the company's record, so asking a question leaves the asset larger than it found it. A chat's answers evaporate.
